title: A computational framework for understanding embodied plans
abstract: arXiv:2611.13669v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning about people's plans and goals based on their actions is fundamental to human social interaction and essential for cooperative, embodied artificial intelligence. Formalizing this capacity in naturalistic, embodied settings has been a longstanding challenge. Here, we present GenEA, a novel agent representation capable of reasoning over multi-step, long-horizon embodied plans. At the heart of GenEA lies a multilevel state-space that couples the coarse biomechanics of an articulated body and its interactions with nearby objects by extending the task-and-motion planning framework from robotics with simulation-based intuitive physics. By embedding this state-space in a generative model, GenEA yields a joint probability distribution over goals and embodied plans. translated_title: 理解具身计划的计算框架
translated_abstract: 根据人们的行动来推理其计划与目标，是人类社会互动的基础，也是协作式具身人工智能的关键能力。在自然、具身的环境中形式化这种能力长期以来一直是一个挑战。本文提出了GenEA，一种新颖的智能体表示方法，能够对多步骤、长时程的具身计划进行推理。GenEA的核心是一个多层级状态空间，它通过将机器人学中的任务与运动规划框架与基于模拟的直觉物理学相结合，把关节身体的粗略生物力学及其与邻近物体的交互耦合在一起。通过将该状态空间嵌入生成模型，GenEA给出了目标与具身计划的联合概率分布。在跨越物体操作与导航这两个性质迥异领域的多项实验中，涵盖多样化任务和多种行为测量指标，我们……
tldr: 该论文提出GenEA框架，通过将融合身体生物力学与直觉物理学的多层级状态空间嵌入生成模型，实现了从人类动作出发对多步骤长时程具身计划与目标的联合概率推理。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GenEA, a novel agent representation that embeds a multilevel state-space—coupling body biomechanics with simulation-based intuitive physics—into a generative model, enabling joint probabilistic reasoning over goals and multi-step, long-horizon embodied plans from observed actions.
